documents.title: Ukraine defies Trump and launches one of its biggest drone attacks on Russia this year
documents.lead: Ukrainian drones set fire to the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal. The governor of St. Petersburg reported fires at the Ruchyi oil depot and several industrial warehouses.

documents.title: St. Petersburg Oil Terminal Set Ablaze Amid Ukraine Drone Strikes
documents.lead: Fires broke out at the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal after a wave of Ukrainian drone strikes, the governor said.

documents.title: Vladimir Putin's Hometown St. Petersburg Goes Up in Flames in Defiant Overnight Ukraine Attack
documents.lead: One person was killed and 15 injured in the overnight Ukrainian drone attack on St. Petersburg, officials said. Fires broke out at the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal.

documents.title: Trump slams Zelensky after Ukraine defies US president with major attack on Russia
documents.lead: President Trump criticized President Zelensky after Ukraine launched one of its biggest drone attacks on Russia this year. Russia's Defense Ministry said it destroyed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 regions.

documents.title: Ukraine and Russia exchange strikes, as relations between Trump and Zelenskyy sour
documents.lead: President Trump criticized Ukraine's leader after one of Ukraine's biggest drone attacks on Russia this year. Fires broke out at the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal.
